title: Kiki / Overview
description: Headline health: traffic, replies, latency, LLM spend, errors, queue and resources. Metric catalog: docs/observability.md.

panels.title: Messages in
panels.description: Live MESSAGE_CREATEs from people in the selected range (catch-up pages excluded).

panels.title: Replies sent
panels.description: Reply messages Kiki sent in the selected range (a reply can be several messages).

panels.title: Reply rate
panels.description: Agent runs finished `done` per human message ingested, over the selected range: how often Kiki speaks up.

panels.title: Run success
panels.description: Share of agent runs that finished `done`, of those not superseded by a newer run (failed, expired and interrupted count against it).

panels.title: Reply latency p50
panels.description: Trigger message created → first reply message sent, over the selected range (kiki.reply.latency; buckets 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 s, so values are interpolated).

links.title: Slow agent runs (> 20 s) in Tempo

panels.title: Reply latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of reply latency over the selected range.

links.title: Slow agent runs (> 20 s) in Tempo

panels.title: Messages in and out per hour
panels.description: Hourly rate (average per hour over each bar). In: live messages ingested by author (human, bot, kiki). Out: messages Kiki sent, by kind.

panels.title: Reply latency
panels.description: p50 and p95 of trigger message → first reply, per interval (at least 15 min, since replies are few). Click a point for Tempo links to agent run traces.

links.title: Slow agent runs (> 20 s) in Tempo

panels.title: Spend today
panels.description: OpenRouter cost since midnight (browser time zone), both services. The daily spend alert fires above $5 over a rolling 24 h.

panels.title: Spend, last 7 days
panels.description: OpenRouter cost over the last 7 days, both services.

panels.title: Rolling 24 h spend by purpose (7 days)
panels.description: Spend over the 24 h before each point, stacked by purpose (jev from the ingester, the rest from the agent host): the quantity the daily spend alert compares with its threshold (dashed, $5 by default).

panels.title: Spend by model (selected range)
panels.description: Cost and calls per model over the selected range. Models past the 16th distinct one per process show as `other`.

panels.title: Errors (rolling 1 h)
panels.description: Rolling 1 h: each point counts the hour before it. The agent host exports only after a job, so a shorter window often holds a single sample of a series and increase() returns nothing for it. Failures in the hour before each point: agent runs failed, expired or interrupted; Discord sends that failed; LLM calls not `ok`; agent host responses other than 2xx (503 while it wakes is normal); Gateway payloads that failed to store.

panels.title: Agent queue
panels.description: Pending agent runs and drawings (left) and the age of the oldest pending one (right, seconds; 0 when empty). Polled by the leader every 60 s. The alert fires when a run waits more than 2 min.

panels.title: ingester memory
panels.description: Railway memory of the ingester service (needs RAILWAY_METRICS_TOKEN on the ingester).

panels.title: agent memory
panels.description: Railway memory of the agent service (needs RAILWAY_METRICS_TOKEN on the ingester).

panels.title: postgres memory
panels.description: Railway memory of the postgres service (needs RAILWAY_METRICS_TOKEN on the ingester). Postgres's limit is 384 MB.

panels.title: vCPU (all)
panels.description: Sum of Railway vCPU usage across services.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: pg_database_size of Kiki's database.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Client backends on the server (all states).

panels.title: Stuck runs
panels.description: Runs running or delivering for over 10 minutes.
